== Title ==
<span lang="ja">R2-Q2 (アートゥ・キュートゥ)</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">搭乗する宇宙戦闘機の戦闘力、回避力、航行速度に＋1。自分のドロー・フェイズにアクセス・リンクのある場所にいたなら、1フォース消費して、自分のリザーブ・デッキのカードを上から3枚まで見ることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">R2ユニットはコンピュータへのデータ送信を専門としている。R2-Q2は銀河拡張界に駐屯する帝国軍偵察艦隊で数十年にわたって働いてきた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo)]].

'''Lore''' — R2 units specialize in sending data to computers. R2-Q2 spent several decades with an Imperial reconnaissance fleet stationed in the Expansion Region.

'''Game text''' — Adds 1 to the power, maneuver, and hyperspeed of the starfighter he is aboard. If he is at an access link during your draw phase, spend 1 Force to look at up to 3 cards from the top of your Reserve Deck.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese looks at up to 3 cards from the Reserve Deck. English looks at the top three of the Reserve Pile. Japanese uses アクセス・リンク for Scomp link.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-r2q2-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo)]].</ref>
